user_saw: Plain-text Telegram replies silently dropped placeholders and generic type arguments, leaving commands like `/model <provider/model> -s` with missing arguments.
summary: The shared plain-text sanitizer now preserves bare angle-bracket names when they are neither standard HTML elements nor paired with a closing tag.
reasoning: The sanitizer already deleted these placeholders at the July 1 shallow boundary through `current.replace(HTML_TAG_RE, "")`, and the comparison fix in #152671 retained that behavior. The older path history stopped at a missing object, so I could not verify when the stripping was introduced or whether plain-text delivery had previously preserved those placeholders.
